snapshot.text: Finnair, the Finnish network carrier, ended FY2025 with net leverage down to {{net_leverage@FY2025}} from {{net_leverage@FY2024}}, in line with the peer median, while revenue was broadly unchanged at {{revenue@FY2025}}.
